entities.summary: Nancy E. Snow is a professor of philosophy specializing in ethics at the University of Kansas. Her recent courses include Introduction to Ethics and Topics in the History of Philosophy. Prior to her move to Lawrence, she was a professor of philosophy and director of the Institute for the Study of Human Flourishing at the University of Oklahoma. Prior to her move to Norman, she was a professor of philosophy at Marquette University.
